audit_item: A08 / Binance archive and shared data timestamp input boundaries
finding: Archive imports leaked low-level errors for malformed public parameters; invalid delays were rejected after fetching; the shared UTC timestamp parser silently normalized Unicode digits; and fetch_archive did not reject URL syntax or dot-segment traversal in its relative path.
change: Both public archive imports now validate symbol/date/instrument/delay inputs before output creation or fetch. Shared UTC ISO parsing accepts ASCII digits only. fetch_archive now rejects absolute paths, dot segments, empty segments, query/fragment/percent/backslash syntax, and paths outside daily/monthly namespaces before creating cache directories or accessing network.
